# Sedco Plumbing

> Sedco Plumbing is a licensed plumbing contractor (California C-36) based in El Cajon, CA, serving homes, rentals and businesses across East County and San Diego County. Open 24 hours Monday to Saturday. Free estimates, no trip charge, and a 30-day guarantee on all work. Call (619) 714-0027.

## Key facts

- Business: Sedco Plumbing, a locally owned plumbing company in El Cajon, California
- License: California C-36 (plumbing) contractor
- Experience: 20 years serving San Diego County
- Rating: 5.0 on Google
- Phone: (619) 714-0027
- Email: webforms@sedcoplumbing.com
- Website: https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/
- Hours: open 24 hours Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday
- Service model: a service-area business; plumbers come to the customer. There is no storefront or walk-in location.
- Customers: homeowners, landlords, property managers, HOAs, restaurants and other businesses

## Pricing and policies

- Free estimates, with an upfront price before any work starts
- No trip charge
- Same price at night and on Saturdays
- 30-day guarantee on all work
- Service requests get a call back within 30 minutes, Monday to Saturday
- Same-day visits are usually available

## How to book

- Call (619) 714-0027 to speak with someone at any hour, Monday to Saturday
- Or request service online: https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/contact/

## Services

- [General plumbing](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/general-plumbing/): plumbing repairs, leaks, fixtures and inspections for homes and businesses
- [Drain cleaning](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/drain-cleaning/): clogged kitchen, bathroom and main line drains, including emergency drain cleaning
- [Sewer line repair and replacement](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/sewer-lines/): broken sewer pipes, tree root damage and sewage backups
- [Water heater repair and installation](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/water-heater/): tank and tankless water heaters, repair and replacement
- [Slab leak detection and repair](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/slab-leak-repair/): finding and fixing leaks under concrete foundations
- [Repiping and water line repair](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/water-lines/): main water line replacement and whole-house repiping
- [Gas line repair and installation](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/gas-lines/): gas leak repair and gas hookups for stoves, dryers and BBQs
- [Water pressure regulators](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/water-pressure-regulators/): pressure testing and pressure regulator (PRV) replacement
- [Water filtration systems](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/water-filtration/): whole-house and under-sink water filter installation
- [Toilet repair and installation](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/toilet-repair-installation/): running, leaking and clogged toilets, and toilet replacement
- [Faucet repair and installation](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/faucet-services/): leaking faucets and kitchen and bathroom faucet replacement
- [Sink repair and installation](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/sink-services/): leaking or clogged sinks and new kitchen and bathroom sinks
- [Garbage disposal repair and installation](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/garbage-disposal/): jammed, leaking or broken disposals, repaired or replaced
- [Shower installation](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/shower-installation/): new showers, shower valve replacement and tub-to-shower conversions
- [Kitchen and bath remodel plumbing](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/kitchen-bath-remodels/): plumbing rough-in and fixture installation for remodels
- [Grease trap services](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/grease-trap/): grease trap installation, repair and maintenance for restaurants and commercial kitchens
- [Property management plumbing](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/property-management-plumbing/): repairs and tenant calls for landlords, property managers and HOAs
- [All plumbing services](https://www.sedcoplumbing.com/services/)
